definitionEn: A particular domain of activity, knowledge, social life, or political influence.
meaningVi: lĩnh vực, phạm vi ảnh hưởng; hình cầu
existingExample: Artificial intelligence is rapidly permeating every sphere of modern commerce, from logistics to diagnostics.

definitionEn: Lower in rank, status, authority, or importance relative to another entity.
meaningVi: cấp dưới, thứ yếu, phụ thuộc
existingExample: Long-term ecological stability should never be treated as subordinate to short-term quarterly profits.

definitionEn: To add an extra element or amount to something in order to enhance, strengthen, or complete it.
meaningVi: bổ sung, phụ thêm vào để hoàn thiện
existingExample: Online interactive tutorials can effectively supplement traditional classroom lectures rather than replace them.

definitionEn: To temporarily stop an activity, right, or service from continuing for a period of time.
meaningVi: đình chỉ, tạm dừng, treo (giấy phép, hoạt động)
existingExample: Aviation regulators decided to suspend all flights over the region until volcanic ash levels subsided.

definitionEn: A group of individuals working collaboratively toward a shared professional, academic, or athletic objective.
meaningVi: đội ngũ, nhóm chuyên gia phối hợp
existingExample: An interdisciplinary team of epidemiologists and urban designers collaborated to evaluate neighbourhood walkability.

definitionEn: Lasting or intended to function only for a limited period rather than permanently.
meaningVi: tạm thời, nhất thời, không lâu dài
existingExample: Emergency fuel subsidies offer only temporary relief and fail to address underlying energy inefficiency.

definitionEn: To cause an event, reaction, or chain of consequences to happen suddenly.
meaningVi: kích hoạt, châm ngòi, gây ra phản ứng dây chuyền
existingExample: Prolonged droughts in major grain-exporting regions can trigger severe global food price spikes.

definitionEn: To bring separate groups, standards, or elements together into a single cohesive whole.
meaningVi: thống nhất, hợp nhất thành một thể chung
existingExample: International sporting tournaments can temporarily unify diverse populations around a shared sense of pride.

definitionEn: To break or fail to comply with a law, formal agreement, ethical standard, or fundamental right.
meaningVi: vi phạm (luật pháp, quyền riêng tư, chuẩn mực)
existingExample: Tech corporations face heavy fines whenever their data-harvesting practices violate national privacy statutes.

definitionEn: The ability to plan or imagine the future with wisdom, foresight, and clear strategic purpose.
meaningVi: tầm nhìn chiến lược, viễn kiến; thị lực
existingExample: Transforming car-centric metropolises into sustainable communities requires bold long-term political vision.

definitionEn: Located immediately next to or sharing a common border with something else.
meaningVi: liền kề, tiếp giáp, kế cận
existingExample: Heavy industrial zones should never be constructed directly adjacent to primary schools or hospitals.

definitionEn: To gather people, evidence, or mechanical components together into an organised whole.
meaningVi: tập hợp, lắp ráp, thu thập lại
existingExample: The parliamentary committee had to assemble experts from across the continent before drafting AI legislation.

definitionEn: To fall down suddenly or fail completely as a structure, system, institution, or ecosystem.
meaningVi: sụp đổ, tan rã, suy sụp đột ngột
existingExample: Marine biologists warn that regional fisheries could collapse within two decades if illegal trawling persists.

definitionEn: To collect and systematically organise information from multiple sources into a report, list, or database.
meaningVi: biên soạn, tổng hợp (dữ liệu, báo cáo)
existingExample: Researchers took three years to compile a comprehensive longitudinal dataset covering fifty urban districts.

definitionEn: To form or devise a plan, idea, or theory in the mind, or to imagine something as possible.
meaningVi: hình thành ý tưởng, thai nghén; hình dung ra
existingExample: Urban architects must conceive innovative housing models that remain affordable without sacrificing liveability.

definitionEn: To persuade someone firmly to believe a claim or adopt a particular course of action through evidence or argument.
meaningVi: thuyết phục hoàn toàn (khiến ai tin hoặc đồng thuận)
existingExample: Transparent empirical evidence is essential to convince sceptical motorists to switch to public transit.

definitionEn: To reduce the level, value, or activity of an economy or market, or to lower someone's mood.
meaningVi: làm suy giảm, kéo tụt (kinh tế, giá trị); gây trầm cảm
existingExample: Excessive household debt tends to depress consumer demand and prolong post-recession recovery.

definitionEn: To unexpectedly experience or be confronted with a challenge, obstacle, or unfamiliar situation.
meaningVi: đối mặt, gặp phải (khó khăn, trở ngại, hiện tượng)
existingExample: First-generation university graduates often encounter structural barriers when entering elite corporate professions.

definitionEn: Extremely large in scale, amount, impact, or significance.
meaningVi: khổng lồ, to lớn, cực kỳ đáng kể
existingExample: Decarbonising global aviation presents an enormous engineering challenge that cannot be solved overnight.

definitionEn: About to happen, be published, or become available soon; willing to share information openly.
meaningVi: sắp tới, sắp diễn ra; sẵn lòng cung cấp thông tin
existingExample: The forthcoming international climate summit will determine binding emission targets for the next decade.

definitionEn: To feel willing or disposed toward a particular belief, opinion, or course of action.
meaningVi: có khuynh hướng, thiên về, nghiêng về
existingExample: Recent consumer surveys incline economists to believe that green products require stronger price incentives.

definitionEn: Belonging naturally and essentially to the core nature of something, independent of external factors.
meaningVi: nội tại, bản chất vốn có, tự thân
existingExample: Preserving endangered wildlife has intrinsic ecological value beyond its measurable contribution to ecotourism.

definitionEn: To cite a law, authority, or principle as justification for an action, or to evoke a strong response.
meaningVi: viện dẫn (luật, nguyên tắc); khơi gợi
existingExample: Several municipalities had to invoke emergency powers to ration drinking water during the historic drought.

definitionEn: To impose and officially collect a tax, fee, or financial charge by legal authority.
meaningVi: đánh thuế, áp đặt khoản thu bắt buộc
existingExample: Several European capitals now levy additional congestion charges on older diesel vehicles entering downtown zones.

definitionEn: Different from what is expected or usual; not divisible by two, or occasional.
meaningVi: khác thường, lẻ, bất thường
existingExample: Auditors noticed several odd statistical discrepancies in the corporation's annual carbon-offset disclosures.

definitionEn: Continuing to exist, develop, or happen without interruption.
meaningVi: đang diễn ra, liên tục, kéo dài
existingExample: Ongoing investment in teacher professional development is vital to sustain gains in national literacy.

definitionEn: A small group of qualified individuals selected to discuss, advise on, or judge an official matter.
meaningVi: hội đồng chuyên gia, ban thẩm định; tấm bảng
existingExample: An independent panel of bioethicists was appointed to review clinical protocols for human genome editing.

definitionEn: To continue to exist or occur despite opposition, difficulty, or corrective measures.
meaningVi: dai dẳng, tiếp diễn; kiên trì bám đuổi
existingExample: Despite decades of equal-pay legislation, stark gender disparities still persist in executive leadership.

definitionEn: To present or constitute a problem, threat, danger, or question requiring serious consideration.
meaningVi: đặt ra (thách thức, nguy cơ, câu hỏi)
existingExample: Unregulated deepfake audio tools pose a serious threat to electoral integrity and public journalism.

definitionEn: Unwilling and hesitant to take a particular action or accept a change.
meaningVi: miễn cưỡng, do dự, không sẵn lòng
existingExample: Small manufacturers are often reluctant to adopt costly green technologies without guaranteed tax credits.

definitionEn: Commonly named in a certain way, often used to express scepticism about the label's accuracy.
meaningVi: cái gọi là (thường hàm ý hoài nghi hoặc mỉa mai)
existingExample: Many so-called biodegradable plastics actually require industrial composting facilities to break down safely.

definitionEn: Uncomplicated, clear, and easy to understand or carry out.
meaningVi: đơn giản, rõ ràng, dễ hiểu, trực diện
existingExample: Designing a fair carbon pricing system is far less straightforward than proponents initially suggested.

definitionEn: to distribute resources, funds, or duties for a specific purpose.
meaningVi: phân bổ (ngân sách, nguồn lực)
existingExample: Governments should allocate more funding to primary education.

definitionEn: having important and widely applicable effects or implications.
meaningVi: có tầm ảnh hưởng sâu rộng
existingExample: This trend is likely to have far-reaching implications for society as a whole.

definitionEn: a room, building, or place in which someone may live or stay.
meaningVi: chỗ ở, nơi lưu trú
existingExample: Finding affordable student accommodation near university campuses has become increasingly challenging.

definitionEn: a set of written questions used for gathering statistical or survey data.
meaningVi: bảng câu hỏi khảo sát
existingExample: Researchers distributed an anonymous questionnaire to over five hundred local residents.

definitionEn: a piece of work or task allocated to someone as part of a course or job.
meaningVi: bài tập lớn, nhiệm vụ được giao
existingExample: University students must submit their written assignment before the Friday deadline.

definitionEn: a period of intensive tuition given by a university tutor to an individual or small group.
meaningVi: buổi học hướng dẫn nhóm nhỏ
existingExample: Each weekly tutorial allows undergraduates to discuss complex readings with their lecturer.

definitionEn: a conference or university class for discussion and academic training on a specific topic.
meaningVi: hội thảo chuyên đề
existingExample: Postgraduate scholars presented their preliminary findings at the international seminar.

definitionEn: a half-year term in a school or university academic calendar.
meaningVi: học kỳ đại học
existingExample: Exchange students typically spend one full semester studying at a partner institution abroad.

definitionEn: a long, formal essay on a particular subject written for a university degree.
meaningVi: luận văn, luận án học thuật
existingExample: She spent an entire year conducting field research for her doctoral dissertation.

definitionEn: a systematic list of books and scholarly sources referred to in an academic work.
meaningVi: danh mục tài liệu tham khảo
existingExample: Every academic paper must include an accurate bibliography formatted according to citation rules.

definitionEn: a structured schedule showing the times at which classes, trains, or events occur.
meaningVi: thời khóa biểu, lịch trình cố định
existingExample: A well-balanced school timetable should allocate adequate hours to both arts and sciences.

definitionEn: the action of officially registering as a member of an institution or course.
meaningVi: sự đăng ký nhập học, sĩ số ghi danh
existingExample: University enrolment in computer science courses has surged dramatically over the past decade.

definitionEn: the governing body of a nation, state, or community with authority to enact policies.
meaningVi: chính phủ, cơ quan cầm quyền
existingExample: The central government introduced stricter emissions targets to combat urban air pollution.

definitionEn: an institution where objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest are preserved and exhibited.
meaningVi: bảo tàng
existingExample: Free admission to national museum collections encourages greater public engagement with history.

definitionEn: the principal church of a diocese, often notable for historic architecture.
meaningVi: nhà thờ chính tòa, giáo đường lớn
existingExample: Conservationists are restoring the medieval cathedral to preserve its intricate stonework.

definitionEn: a sheltered coastal area where ships can dock safely for trade or transport.
meaningVi: bến cảng, hải cảng
existingExample: Modernising the commercial harbour significantly expanded the city's maritime trade capacity.

definitionEn: a building designed for dramatic performances, or the art of live stage production.
meaningVi: nhà hát, nghệ thuật sân khấu
existingExample: Public subsidies help regional theatre companies stage innovative productions for local audiences.

definitionEn: a circular road junction at which traffic flows continuously in one direction.
meaningVi: vòng xuyến, bùng binh giao thông
existingExample: Replacing traffic lights with a modern roundabout reduced peak-hour congestion by thirty percent.

definitionEn: the highest legislative assembly of a democratic country responsible for enacting laws.
meaningVi: quốc hội, nghị viện
existingExample: Members of parliament debated the proposed climate legislation for several consecutive days.

definitionEn: a shop or dispensary where medicinal drugs are prepared and sold, or the science of pharmacology.
meaningVi: hiệu thuốc, ngành dược học
existingExample: Expanding rural pharmacy services ensures that elderly patients receive timely prescriptions.

definitionEn: an arrangement made in advance to secure a room, seat, or service, or an expression of doubt.
meaningVi: sự đặt chỗ trước; sự dè dặt
existingExample: Visitors are advised to make an online reservation well ahead of the peak tourist season.

definitionEn: a written or digital acknowledgement confirming that payment or goods have been received.
meaningVi: biên lai, hóa đơn thanh toán
existingExample: Consumers should retain their digital receipt in order to claim warranty repairs or refunds.

definitionEn: a sum of money paid as a first instalment or security, or a natural layer of minerals.
meaningVi: tiền đặt cọc; mỏ khoáng sản
existingExample: High housing prices make it difficult for young buyers to save enough for a mortgage deposit.

definitionEn: a repayment of a sum of money to a customer who is dissatisfied or whose service was cancelled.
meaningVi: khoản tiền hoàn trả
existingExample: Consumer protection laws entitle passengers to a full refund when flights are cancelled without notice.

definitionEn: a deduction from the usual cost of something, often offered to encourage sales.
meaningVi: sự giảm giá, chiết khấu
existingExample: Offering a substantial discount on annual rail passes encourages commuters to abandon private cars.

definitionEn: a financial arrangement providing guaranteed compensation for specified loss, damage, or illness.
meaningVi: bảo hiểm
existingExample: Universal health insurance protects low-income households from catastrophic medical expenses.

definitionEn: an official permit from an authority to own, use, or carry out a regulated activity.
meaningVi: giấy phép chính thức
existingExample: Every commercial operator must obtain an environmental licence before commencing construction.

definitionEn: an object purchased or kept as a reminder of a place visited or an event experienced.
meaningVi: quà lưu niệm
existingExample: Local artisans earn vital revenue by crafting authentic handmade souvenir items for travellers.

definitionEn: a small booklet or pamphlet containing descriptive information about a product or destination.
meaningVi: tờ gấp giới thiệu, ấn phẩm quảng bá
existingExample: Tourism boards now publish interactive digital versions alongside every printed travel brochure.

definitionEn: a planned route or detailed schedule of activities for a journey.
meaningVi: lịch trình chi tiết (chuyến đi)
existingExample: Careful planning of an eco-tourism itinerary helps minimise the environmental impact of travel.

definitionEn: suitcases and bags used to pack personal belongings for travelling.
meaningVi: hành lý
existingExample: Strict airline luggage restrictions have prompted travellers to adopt more minimalist packing habits.

definitionEn: a person who does not eat meat or fish, especially for moral, health, or environmental reasons.
meaningVi: người ăn chay; chế độ ăn chay
existingExample: Adopting a vegetarian lifestyle can markedly reduce an individual's greenhouse gas footprint.

definitionEn: relating to the kinds of food habitually consumed by a person or community.
meaningVi: thuộc về chế độ ăn uống
existingExample: Public health campaigns emphasise balanced dietary habits to curb rising rates of heart disease.

definitionEn: the degree or intensity of heat present in a substance, environment, or body.
meaningVi: nhiệt độ
existingExample: Climatologists warn that a two-degree rise in global temperature will destabilise polar ice sheets.

definitionEn: a damaging immune response by the body to a normally harmless substance such as pollen or food.
meaningVi: chứng dị ứng
existingExample: Clear ingredient labelling is essential for protecting consumers who suffer from a severe food allergy.

definitionEn: an arrangement to meet someone at a set time, or the act of assigning a person to an official post.
meaningVi: cuộc hẹn; sự bổ nhiệm
existingExample: Telemedicine platforms allow patients to book a medical appointment without travelling to clinics.

definitionEn: a person's regular profession, trade, or means of earning a living.
meaningVi: nghề nghiệp, công việc chuyên môn
existingExample: Rapid automation is transforming almost every traditional occupation across manufacturing and finance.

definitionEn: the legal status of belonging to a particular nation by birth or naturalisation.
meaningVi: quốc tịch
existingExample: International research teams bring together specialists regardless of their background or nationality.

definitionEn: a person with whom one works in a profession, organisation, or academic department.
meaningVi: đồng nghiệp
existingExample: Collaborating closely with an experienced colleague accelerates professional development for new graduates.

definitionEn: an administrative employee who greets visitors and manages enquiries at an organisation's entrance.
meaningVi: nhân viên lễ tân
existingExample: Digital check-in kiosks are gradually assisting the front-desk receptionist in busy urban hotels.

definitionEn: a retired person who receives a regular state or private pension.
meaningVi: người hưởng lương hưu
existingExample: Rising inflation disproportionately erodes the purchasing power of every fixed-income pensioner.

definitionEn: needed in order to achieve a particular result or fulfil an essential requirement.
meaningVi: cần thiết, thiết yếu
existingExample: Decisive policy intervention is necessary to halt the rapid decline of coastal ecosystems.

definitionEn: fitting in well with a person's needs, schedule, and practical circumstances.
meaningVi: thuận tiện, tiện lợi
existingExample: Contactless transit cards provide a remarkably convenient payment method for daily rail commuters.

definitionEn: the necessary tools, machinery, or apparatus required for a particular purpose or profession.
meaningVi: trang thiết bị, dụng cụ chuyên dụng
existingExample: Underfunded rural hospitals frequently struggle to maintain modern diagnostic equipment.

definitionEn: to put forward someone or something as being suitable, beneficial, or advisable.
meaningVi: khuyến nghị, đề xuất
existingExample: Public health experts strongly recommend at least thirty minutes of moderate daily exercise.

definitionEn: coming between two extremes, stages, or levels of knowledge and proficiency.
meaningVi: trung cấp, ở mức trung gian
existingExample: Language learners at an intermediate level benefit greatly from reading authentic academic articles.

definitionEn: a metric unit of measurement equal to one thousand metres.
meaningVi: ki-lô-mét (đơn vị đo khoảng cách)
existingExample: High-speed rail networks now transport passengers at over three hundred kilometre speeds per hour.

definitionEn: shaped like a rectangle with four straight sides and four right angles.
meaningVi: có hình chữ nhật
existingExample: The architectural blueprint features a spacious rectangular courtyard surrounded by solar-roofed classrooms.

definitionEn: increased rapidly and by a substantial margin within a short period.
meaningVi: tăng vọt, tăng mạnh đột ngột
existingExample: The number of visitors rose sharply from 2 million to 5 million between 2010 and 2015.

definitionEn: stayed at a consistent level without noticeable upward or downward fluctuation.
meaningVi: duy trì ổn định, không biến động
existingExample: Sales remained stable at around 400 units for the rest of the period.

definitionEn: reached the highest recorded value or point before declining.
meaningVi: đạt mức đỉnh điểm ở
existingExample: Unemployment peaked at 12% in 2009 before declining steadily in today's competitive and rapidly shifting labour market.

definitionEn: a sudden, substantial, and striking decrease in a measured quantity.
meaningVi: sự sụt giảm mạnh mẽ
existingExample: There was a dramatic fall in the price of solar panels.

definitionEn: to rise and fall irregularly in number, level, or intensity over time.
meaningVi: biến động, dao động lên xuống
existingExample: Global oil prices tend to fluctuate wildly during periods of geopolitical uncertainty.

definitionEn: dropped to the lowest recorded level during a given timeframe.
meaningVi: chạm mức thấp nhất là
existingExample: Car ownership reached a low of 15% in 1990.

definitionEn: increased to more than twice its original amount or size.
meaningVi: tăng hơn gấp đôi
existingExample: Exports more than doubled over the period shown.

definitionEn: grew to almost three times the initial figure over a given period.
meaningVi: tăng gần gấp ba lần
existingExample: The amount of waste recycled nearly tripled between 2000 and 2020.

definitionEn: to move towards and meet at a common point, value, or conclusion.
meaningVi: hội tụ, tiến gần đến cùng một điểm
existingExample: Income levels across the two neighbouring regions began to converge rapidly after trade barriers fell.

definitionEn: an immediately noticeable or remarkable characteristic of a dataset or phenomenon.
meaningVi: đặc điểm nổi bật đáng chú ý
existingExample: Over the period shown, the most striking feature is the rapid growth of online sales.

definitionEn: greater in amount, degree, or value by only a small margin.
meaningVi: cao hơn một chút, nhỉnh hơn đôi chút
existingExample: The figure for men was slightly higher than that for women.

definitionEn: almost all of a group, population, or total amount.
meaningVi: đại đa số, phần lớn áp đảo
existingExample: The vast majority of students (87%) used a laptop.

definitionEn: opposite in nature, direction, or meaning to a stated belief or expectation.
meaningVi: trái ngược với
existingExample: Contrary to popular belief, older workers are often more productive.

definitionEn: to be heavier, greater, or more significant than an opposing factor.
meaningVi: lấn át, vượt trội hơn về giá trị
existingExample: The advantages of online learning outweigh its drawbacks.

definitionEn: a clear, concrete instance that directly illustrates or proves a general statement.
meaningVi: ví dụ điển hình, minh chứng xác đáng
existingExample: A case in point is Singapore, where public transport is cheap and efficient.

definitionEn: extremely delighted, thrilled, or ecstatic about a positive outcome.
meaningVi: vô cùng hạnh phúc, phấn khởi tột độ
existingExample: I was over the moon when I got the scholarship.

definitionEn: a visual image captured by a camera on light-sensitive film or a digital sensor.
meaningVi: bức ảnh chụp
existingExample: A single documentary photograph can raise more public awareness than pages of dry statistics.

definitionEn: the art, science, or professional practice of taking and processing photographs.
meaningVi: nhiếp ảnh, nghệ thuật chụp ảnh
existingExample: Wildlife photography plays an influential role in inspiring global conservation movements.

definitionEn: relating to economics, trade, industry, or the financial system of a nation.
meaningVi: thuộc về kinh tế
existingExample: Sustained investment in green infrastructure can stimulate long-term economic growth.

definitionEn: to grow, evolve, or cause something to become more advanced, mature, or elaborate.
meaningVi: phát triển, xây dựng và mở rộng
existingExample: Primary curricula should help young learners develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
